verdict.rationale: There is thin evidence of versioning: the docs index is labeled V1 with 'Legacy V0' pages excluded, and a published OpenAPI spec exists for the documented HTTP/WebSocket agent server API. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, timelines, or how API versions are guaranteed. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, an explicit API versioning scheme (e.g. versioned endpoints or semver guarantees), sunset/migration timelines, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: LLM-friendly index of OpenHands documentation (V1). Legacy V0 docs pages are intentionally excluded.
runs the OpenHands Software Agent SDK behind an HTTP and WebSocket API
